messages:
Jamal Carter: Morning async — quick check-in on an escalation from Northbrook Health. CS ticket CS-4892. Issue: renewals failing when external webhook payloads exceed ~64KB, we see 500s and retries. What I did: reproduced in staging, captured logs, added a minimal failing payload.

Blockers: root cause unknown (maybe parser mismatch or body size limit). Need eng triage and a small patch for safe parsing + fallback. Today: request a reviewer for PR and a brief canary. @Rohan Singh can you take the triage? @Lina Park FYI on rollout window.

Attached logs:
```
2026-03-02T16:12:03Z ERROR webhook-handler: /api/v1/renewal POST -> 500
stack: parseMetadata() -> null pointer at src/webhook/parser.go:128
payload_size=66512 bytes customer_id=NBK-711
```

---
Rohan Singh: On it. I'll look after 09:00 PT. Can you paste the exact sample payload (strip PII) or a minimized repro? If it's size-related we can short-circuit metadata parsing and return 200 with queued processing as a stopgap.

Jamal Carter: Pasted sample to the ticket (CS-4892) and uploaded to s3://redwood-cs-dumps/nbk/nbk-20260302.json.gz — redwood-s3 link. Minimal curl to reproduce:
```
curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/api/v1/renewal -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @nbk-20260302.json
```

---
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-20260302-74 linked to CS-4892. Severity: P2. Notifying on-call.

Rohan Singh: Quick skim: parser.go line 128 assumes `metadata.payload` exists; larger payloads sometimes move metadata to nested `attachments` array. I'll open a branch `rfix/webhook-meta-safe` and add nil checks + a streaming parse fallback for >64KB. Draft PR soon (will add unit tests + reproduce harness).

Priya Patel: Thanks — what's impact on renewals count? Do we have customers blocked in the past 24h besides Northbrook?

Jamal Carter: Northbrook is the only known customer currently on the impacted renewal run; manual workaround sent earlier (resend as gzip chunked) but they prefer code fix. Escalation if we don't patch before their renewal window (tomorrow 10:00 PT).

Rohan Singh: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/842 (work-in-progress). Tests added. Summary: add safe metadata accessor, streaming decoder for large bodies, fallback queue+ack response. Leaving TODO to add metric for `webhook.large_payload_handled`.

Lina Park: I'll review after standup. Propose 1-hour canary starting 11:30 PT with traffic routed to canary and health checks for 15min. If green, rollout to production. @Priya Patel is that acceptable for customer comms window?

Priya Patel: 11:30 PT is okay. Please ensure we include a rollback plan — prefer feature-flagged canary so we can flip instantly.

Rohan Singh: Will add feature flag and a quick rollback doc in PR description. Tagging @Lina Park for review request.

Lina Park: Ack, will review PR #842 and the rollback steps. :eyes:

Jamal Carter: Thanks team — marking this as in-progress. I'll update CS-4892 with the canary plan and notify Northbrook's engineering contact once we have PR merged. Ping me if you need any sample data or access. :thumbsup:

---
Lina Park: Reviewed, left minor comments on tests. Approving pending test fix. Planning canary at 11:30 PT. :white_check_mark:

Rohan Singh: Tests fixed and PR updated. Merging shortly and kicking the canary. Rolling status will be in the release channel.

Jamal Carter: Noted, will stand by for rollout confirmation and update CS. Thanks everyone.
